Name: Moonflower's Scarecrows (AT and CP)
Author: GentleMoonflower
Description:
[font=Georgia][color=#d9d2e9][size=4]☽ How to Install ☾[/size][/color]

[b][color=#d9d2e9][center][/center][/color][/b]

Two versions are available. You only need to download one (but you're welcome to download both if you want to. I haven't tested it but they shouldn't conflict):
﻿ ﻿
[center]1. [b][color=#d9d2e9][u]Content Patcher[/u][/color][/b][/center][b][color=#d9d2e9][u]
[/u][/color][/b]Will [u]replace[/u] the vanilla scarecrows with reskins. This means you will need to obtain rarecrows through regular gameplay ﻿(unless you have a mod like item spawner installed).

[center]2. [b][color=#d9d2e9][u]Alternative Textures[/u][/color][/b][/center][b][color=#d9d2e9][u]
[/u][/color][/b]Will allow you to [u]choose[/u] which scarecrow you want to replace with [u]any[/u] of the available reskins (via the paint bucket). Visit the alternative textures mod if you want more information on how to apply these changes. 
﻿
[b][color=#d9d2e9]Extra Scarecrows (Optional)[/color] [/b]- I made [i]many [/i]changes as I worked on this mod. As a bonus, I have included the old [b][color=#8e7cc3]purple version [/color][/b]of the snail which you can download. However, you will need to replace the .png picture yourself. Just make sure to rename ﻿the "purple snail" .png accordingly (ex. "rarecrow_6" for content patcher, and "texture_7" for alternative textures). If I make any other versions of scarecrows, I will add them to the "Extra Scarecrows" folder. I may include it as a configurable option in the future but I can't guarantee anything. 

[color=#d9d2e9]
[size=4]
☽ Requirements ☾[/size][/color]
[size=2][color=#f4f4f4]
You will need to have [b][u]Content Patcher [CP][/u][/b] installed for the content patcher version of this mod, and [b][u]Alternative Textures [AT][/u][/b] for the alternative textures version. As with most other mods, you will also need to have SMAPI installed. 

[/color][/size]
[size=4][left][color=#d9d2e9]
☽ Do Not Repost, Please ☾[/color][/left][/size][size=2]
I spent a lot of time on this mod since I'm not familiar with pixel art. I ask that you please do not repost my work. If you're creating a mod and would like to use any of my assets, definitely feel free to contact me through Nexus Mods.
[/size]
[size=4]
[color=#d9d2e9]
☽ Overview of Scarecrows [/color][/size][color=#d9d2e9]☾[/color]

﻿1. [b]Farmer: [/b]N[i]ow with a cute (purely decorative) sunflower on their hat.
[/i]
﻿2. [b]Turnip Head: [/b]S[i]ame as vanilla but recoloured to look more 'earthy' (as is fitting whenever turnips are involved). 
[/i]
﻿3. [b]Witch: [/b][i]Redone to look more modern. I love the vanilla design (reminds me of the Wicked Witch of the West) but I wanted to try something different. 
[/i]
﻿4. [b]Robot: [/b][i]Maru will surely approve (+45).
[/i]
﻿5.[b] Snowman: [/b][i]Wearing a more leisurely, knitted hat instead of top hat.
[/i]
﻿6. [b]Feminine Farmer: [/b][i]Now with a flower crown.[/i][i]
[/i]
﻿7. [b]Snail sitting on a mushroom: [/b][i]Watching over your farm idly. 
[/i]
﻿8. [b]Fox perched on a log: [/b]O[i]ne cunning look will scare away all and any crows, I promise.
[/i]
﻿9. [b]Dryad: [/b][i]i.e. A beautiful nature spirit....You may spot one during your next tabletop adventure.
[/i]
﻿10. [b]Howl Jenkins Pendragon: [/b][i]I picked this version so he would (hopefully) be more recognizable.

[/i]

[color=#d9d2e9][size=4]☽ Other Mods, as Shown Above [/size]☾[/color]
[/font]
﻿[font=Georgia]I like to use DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour in my game, so I tried to make these scarecrows 'earthy'. However, the colour palette I used is my own so it's not a perfect match. Some of the mods shown in the above (preview) images include:
﻿
﻿ ﻿- DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour (& Earthy Interiors)
﻿ ﻿- Elle's Seasonal Buildings
﻿ ﻿- Lnh's New Small Farm
﻿ ﻿- Gwen's Paths
﻿ ﻿- Coii's All Hats Pack
﻿ ﻿- Sugarmaples' Cafe Clothes
﻿ ﻿- Rainmoon's Elf Ear

[/font][font=Georgia] ﻿ ﻿Feel free to check out the amazing work of these creators!

[/font][center][size=4]
[font=Georgia]Phew, that was a lot...but hopefully it answers any questions you may have.﻿
If you have any comments, questions or bugs to report, please feel free to let me know (in the comments). I'll try my best to help.[/font][/size][/center]
[center][font=Georgia][color=#b4a7d6][size=6]
Wishing you a wonderful
playthrough. 
⋆.˚☾˚.⋆

[/size][/color][/font][/center][font=Georgia]
[/font]
